item.title: Timor-Leste Begins Commercial Operation of First International Submarine Cable
item.summary: Timor-Leste has begun the commercial operation of its first international submarine fiber-optic cable system, marking a milestone in the country’s digital infrastructure development and strengthening its connectivity with regional and global telecommunications networks. Prime Minister Kay Rala Xanana Gusmão inaugurated the commercial operation of Cabos de Timor-Leste (CTL), E.P., the state-owned operator of the Timor-Leste South Submarine […] The post Timor-Leste Begins Commercial Operation of First International Submarine Cable appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
